transcript: What a casting announcement to wake up to, cause we just found out that Reeve Carney and Evan Lobo Zada will be leading cabaret on the West End. And I am very excited, in part because Eva Noblezada is my favorite Sally I have ever seen. I thought that her Sally was revelatory, and so the fact that she is coming back is enough to get me excited. But then the fact that she's doing it alongside Reeve, I am so intrigued, because I think that he is going to be so different from every other MC that we've had. Like, this is going to be a rock star MC like we haven't seen before. I guess the closest would be Adam Lambert's MC, which is famously my favorite MC that I saw on Broadway. But Adam's vibe is also very different from Reeves, so, yeah, I'm very interested to see how he does in this role, especially because the MC is such an animated character, and Reeve's characters traditionally are not. So I feel like we're about to see a very different side from Reeve, performance wise, than we've ever seen before, and that's also really exciting. But, yeah, I think it's so cute that they're doing another show together. I think that Eve is gonna slay, and Reeve is a bit of a wild card, but I'm very excited to see what he does with it.
